name: HTTPServer
description: Routes on the built in HTTP server, served below /scripting/ when the server runs with --enable_http_server.

static_functions.name: RegisterRoute
static_functions.description: Registers a route, every request has to be answered with Respond

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The HTTP method of the route

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path below /scripting, it must start with /

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Called on the main thread for every request

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The HTTP method of the route

static_functions.name: Respond
static_functions.description: Answers a request received by a route

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The identifier passed to the route callback

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: The content type of the body
